title: Add the frame-only gold-beside review rule to bee-design
action: Write packages/bee/design/bee-design/additions/frame-review.md, the brief for the fresh-context critic in the Check step, adapted from stageshow references/review.md (MIT, credit it at the end). It must say: the critic gets the frames or screenshots, the page URL, the taste rubric and the closest gold example, and never the builder's plan or reasons; the first question is whether the screen answers this product or could be any product in its category; put the work beside the closest gold example and name the one difference; the bar for a finding is a frame the critic can quote, and a predicted pass or failure is not a finding; rank findings by how much of the screen they spoil, framing first, then hierarchy and density, then motion, then polish; each finding names the frame, what is wrong and a one-line fix; say what could not be checked. Name the five failure shapes as quick tells: too much, too little, boxed in a card like a screenshot, flat with no focal point, bland with no brand. Do not repeat what references/design-review.md or taste-rubric.md already say; link them. Write in plain global English. Then in packages/bee/design/bee-design/SKILL.md add one reference-table row pointing at additions/frame-review.md, and in the Check step's critic line say the critic uses that brief.
